provenance.parent_disclosure: Only aggregate counts, artifact paths, hashes and schema-validation status; case content and exact wording withheld until parent explicitly releases after implementation freeze.
provenance.sources_read: AGENTS and project task state; evaluator schema, scorer and synthetic environment contracts; existing heldout schema; seeded fixture facts; read-tool contracts. Existing datasets are used only for overlap checks, never as templates for input text.

gold_basis.actor: u_demo owns all three seeded orders; u_unseen_other owns none.
gold_basis.state_events: Only explicitly declared status changes are external fixture events. A successful live get_order observation of the new state is required.
gold_basis.minimal_read_contract: Status-only questions require one get_order per requested target; actual shipment-event questions require one track_shipment. An unrelated read tool is not an allowed substitute or free extra call. General policy turns require search_knowledge, up to two calls with no overconstrained query wording.
gold_basis.negative_contract: Missing or ambiguous referents and a new session allow no active tools, pending writes or mutations. A different actor reusing the session must receive INVALID_REQUEST. A foreign explicit-order read may reach the repository and must fail business_rejected without successful foreign output.

validation.method: Unchanged eval.multiturn.load_scenarios Pydantic loader only, unique case IDs and input strings, UTF-8/non-ASCII integrity, zero exact input overlap with both original datasets and old heldout, fixture/expected-state consistency, read-only trajectory constraints and old-heldout SHA preservation.

interpretation_limits: These are synthetic authored checks; passing does not establish general model quality or production authentication.
Unchanged evaluator does not score answer prose; clarification negatives establish absence of unsupported reads rather than quality of clarification text.
No assistant-only antecedent injection is expressible in the unchanged Turn schema; no uncontrolled generated assistant mention is treated as a frozen fixture.
All unseen failures must be retained. Changing a scenario or oracle after first evaluation creates a new version and cannot overwrite this freeze.
